snippet.title: Pick Your Poison - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Pick Your Poison on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575810/Pick_Your_Poison/

Pick Your Poison is a turn-based game of chance against an ominous bartender with curious incentives. What does he want? How do you win? Can you win at all? Play to find out.
